Name: Shaded Eyes
Author: kkulppyam
Description:
[left][/left][center][font=Verdana][size=4][/size][/font][/center][center][/center][center][font=Verdana][size=3]I made this mod because I don't like the farmer's eyes to be flat. Now they will have a little depth like the eyes of the villagers!!
[img]http://i.ibb.co/GdDnjPV/decoraci-n.png[/img]
✦ Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=#b45f06]Smapi[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#b45f06]Content Patcher[/color][/url].
✦ Download the main file only and extract it into the mods folder.

[color=#f6b26b]If you use Get Glam:[/color]
✦ Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=#b45f06]Smapi[/color][/url][color=#a64d79]﻿[/color], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#b45f06]Content Patcher[/color][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044][color=#b45f06]Get Glam[/color][/url].
✦ Download both files, the main and optional, and extract them in the mods folder.
✦ In the Get Glam dresser choose the base 1.
[color=#e69138][i]Caution: Keep in mind that choosing the base will prevent you from changing your face and nose.
If it's a problem for you, I have an alternative: In the dresser, choose accessory 19 instead of the base.[/i]
[i]Example:[/i]
[/color][color=#c27ba0][img]https://i.ibb.co/Q8Vkcj1/SE-Preview-Gif-2.gif[/img]

[/color][color=#f6b26b]If you use [/color][color=#f6b26b]More Elegant Female Farmer body:[/color]
✦ Make sure you have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400][color=#b45f06]Smapi[/color][/url][color=#a64d79]﻿[/color] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][color=#b45f06]Content Patcher[/color][/url].
✦ Replace the original mod files with the ones I modified, each in its respective folder.
[i][color=#e69138](If you don't use the mod, you can safely remove the folder.)[/color][/i]

That's it, enjoy it! ♡[/size][/font][/center]

Manifest.Name: Shaded Eyes
Manifest.Description: Adds a brown shadow to the eyes to give them a bit of depth.
Manifest.Author: kkulppyam
